references.name: James Tobin
references.connection:
Defined the intergenerational equity problem for endowments;
  “spending income without invading capital” framing.

references.name: Harry Markowitz
references.connection:
Mean-variance optimization framework that Swensen uses
  and critiques simultaneously.

references.name: John Maynard Keynes
references.desc: The General Theory; King’s College Cambridge investments
references.connection:
Managed King’s College endowment with equity-oriented philosophy;
  multiple chapter epigraphs.

references.name: Charles D. Ellis
references.desc: Winning the Loser’s Game; foreword author
references.connection:
Foundational work on why active management fails in efficient markets;
  chaired Yale Investment Committee.

references.name: Benjamin Graham
references.connection: Value orientation; the intellectual foundation of buying below intrinsic value.

references.name: Warren Buffett
references.connection:
Cited as the preeminent example of genuine long-run investment skill
  that justifies the search for exceptional active managers.

references.name: Roger Ibbotson & Peng Chen
references.desc: Yale ICF Working Paper on hedge funds
references.connection:
Quantified survivorship and backfill bias: 3.7% + 3.8% = 7.5% total
  inflation of reported hedge fund returns.

references.name: Kaplan & Schoar
references.connection:
Private equity performance study; established persistence of top-quartile
  manager results in VC and LBO.

references.name: Jeremy Grantham
references.connection:
Long-run valuation analysis of S&P 500; cited for evidence that markets
  were overvalued in 2007.

references.name: Roger Lowenstein
references.connection: Definitive account of LTCM’s failure; cited for leverage risk analysis.

references.name: Joseph Schumpeter
references.connection:
Creative destruction as the intellectual framework for venture capital’s
  role in the economy.

references.name: Burton Malkiel
references.desc: Princeton; A Random Walk Down Wall Street
references.connection: Efficient markets evidence; cited for passive management case.

connections.title: I Will Teach You to Be Rich
connections.author: Ramit Sethi
